# Brand Connector Pro (Magic Manta)

Brand Connector Pro at https://magicmanta.com finds and verifies a company's social media profiles from its website URL. This deployment serves a prerendered static frontend with the lookup engine as SpaceFast functions.

## How it works
- Enter a brand's domain on the homepage to retrieve associated social handles across X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and more.
- Profiles declared through JSON-LD/Schema.org sameAs or official-site DOM links get a Verified badge with the evidence source shown.
- Evidence strength is a computed label (strong/moderate/weak from counted signals), never a percentage.
- Search fallback candidates stay Unverified; the app checks whether they link back to the official domain.
- Conflicts between official sources are flagged; each result shows "last checked".
- One-click copying for individual handles or the whole set.

## Pages
- / — single domain lookup
- /batch — look up multiple domains
- /dossier — result dossier view
- /source — source board
- /adapters — platform adapters
- /licenses — open source credits and digital carbon disclosure
- /offline — offline fallback

## Machine API
The lookup engine is exposed as plain HTTP endpoints (no auth) on this deployment:

- POST /api/lookup — JSON body: {"url": "example.com"} (a domain or full URL). Returns a BrandLookupResult: brandName, platforms[] (each with platformId, status, and entries[] carrying handle, url, rating, and evidence strings), notFound[] platform names, and blocked:true when the target site refuses automated access. Rate limit: 20 requests/minute per caller.
- POST /api/search — JSON body: {"query": "brand name"}. Returns an array of SearchHit objects (title, url, snippet). Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per caller. Best-effort DuckDuckGo HTML fallback; may return [] when the search provider blocks automated requests.

Both endpoints validate input strictly, refuse private/internal/loopback targets (SSRF protection), and never store personal data.

## Machine-readable
- /llms.txt — this file
- /.well-known/agent.json — agent card (documents the API above)
- /carbon.txt — digital carbon disclosure (carbon.txt v0.5)
- /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt

## Limits
No sign-in required. No personal data is stored. Share links are self-contained snapshots compressed into the URL hash; no backend storage.
